title: Proof, IdP session and app session over time
desc: Four stages, in an order that is only for reading. Signed in: the proof is used once, the IdP session is open and the app session is open. Proof expires, at NotOnOrAfter or exp, which is not the session's lifetime. IdP session end: app sessions are not necessarily terminated. App session: it may live on, and for Entra the app must revoke it.
